_comment: Template for the IAM identity archive-processor uses. __BUCKET_NAME__ is resolved by archive-processor at startup against its own s3.bucket config and written to {data_dir}/aws-setup/iam-policy.json -- paste that resolved file directly into the console's JSON policy editor (see docs/aws-setup.md). The ConnectivityCheck statement is broader than it needs to be (account-wide s3:ListAllMyBuckets, Resource '*') because that's what the current startup connectivity check actually calls; narrowing it to a bucket-scoped head_bucket check is tracked separately.
